svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Albedo-Watch architecture: people use a React and CesiumJS web app on Cloud Run; a FastAPI backend with Gemini agents and numerical engines calls Google AI, Google Maps Platform and open data, and uses Firestore, Secret Manager, Cloud Scheduler, Cloud Build, Artifact Registry and Cloud Logging.
svg.text: One container on Cloud Run. Gemini reasons, Google Maps Platform and open data sense, and a human approves every order.
